calls.title: Kaizen Gaming and GrowthBook
calls.summary: Kaizen is nearing a contract signing with Optimizely, seeking a robust experimentation platform suitable for their needs, including strong native warehouse integration and EU support. The discussion highlighted Kaizen's focus on enhancing their experimentation maturity by building a center of excellence to run 12 experiments per team using Optimizely. Vasiliki emphasized the importance of statistical methods and governance for accountability, while James advocated for GrowthBook's unique advantages, including strong statistical rigor, AI integration, and a pricing model based on user seats rather than traffic. The meeting laid a foundation for future collaboration through ongoing information sharing and potential demos of GrowthBook's capabilities to meet Kaizen's evolving experimentation goals.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, GrowthBook, Optimizely, Statistical Methods, AI Integration, Data Warehouse
